missing_facts: Constituting law, appointment/jurisdiction and recusal facts.
dimensions.explanation: Fictional rubric illustration. Naming a court and recording adverse rulings does not establish institutional independence, competence, impartiality or lawful jurisdiction.
dimensions.next_verification: Inspect the missing original record and contrary accounts; retain unknown until resolved.
dimensions.applicability: Determination of a criminal charge or rights/obligations in a suit at law. An adverse ruling alone does not establish bias. Assess special/military proceedings and law establishing jurisdiction; core independence/impartiality cannot be displaced by convenience.

missing_facts: Complete transcript and defence witness proffer; the repetition rationale needs fuller review.
dimensions.explanation: Fictional rubric illustration. The recorded asymmetry concerns a meaningful defence opportunity: prosecution questioning was allowed while all reliability questions and the proposed rebuttal witness were refused. Avoiding repetition is recorded but no equivalent defence opportunity is shown. This dimension concerns overall opportunity, distinct from the witness safeguard below.
dimensions.next_verification: Compare both parties' opportunities and the complete reasons for refusing rebuttal.
dimensions.applicability: Fictional determination of a criminal charge; assess actual disadvantage and objective justification.

missing_facts: Nature of the evidence, narrower protective measures and complete closure reasons.
dimensions.explanation: Fictional rubric illustration. A privacy reason is affirmatively recorded, so closure is not presumed unlawful. Closing the whole hearing without considering narrower protection raises a limited, unresolved concern; publication of the order is a separate positive fact.
dimensions.next_verification: Inspect the scope and necessity of closure and applicable exception.
dimensions.applicability: The fixture specifies an evidentiary criminal hearing; privacy exceptions must be examined.

missing_facts: Official statements, presentation of the accused and proof/burden practice.
dimensions.explanation: Fictional rubric illustration. A prosecution or admitted confession is not itself an official prejudgment of guilt. Official statements and burden-of-proof practice are unavailable.
dimensions.next_verification: Inspect the missing original record and contrary accounts; retain unknown until resolved.
dimensions.applicability: Criminal charge through adjudication. Prosecution, detention or an adverse verdict alone does not establish failure; distinguish official statements and presentation from a properly reached finding.

missing_facts: Original receipt, earlier message, verified date of formal charge and delivery.
dimensions.explanation: Fictional rubric illustration. The charge sheet affirmatively sets out law and alleged general facts. Actual delivery is disputed: defence says 5 October while prosecution cites an unreadable 25 September receipt. A limited concern describes unresolved timing; it does not infer lack of charge detail from arrest or preliminary investigation.
dimensions.next_verification: Resolve receipt identity and actual content/timing before any legal conclusion.
dimensions.applicability: Criminal-charge notice; Article 9 arrest information and preliminary-investigation service remain separate.

missing_facts: Full disclosure contents, access logs, defence request and reasoned refusal.
dimensions.explanation: Fictional rubric illustration. The recorded denied adjournment addresses a specific inability to prepare witness questions after late disclosure, rather than document volume alone. The prosecution's repeat-summary account competes with that difficulty but does not resolve access or time to prepare.
dimensions.next_verification: Check the actual preparation needed and any later effective remedy.
dimensions.applicability: Adequacy for the 6 October evidentiary hearing depends on complexity and actual access.

missing_facts: Counsel's account of any unrecorded interference outside the listed consultations.
dimensions.explanation: Fictional rubric illustration. Affirmative entries document chosen counsel, two private consultations and continuous representation at this hearing. Zero is limited to those recorded safeguards; it is not whole-case compliance or a deduction from silence. Preparation adequacy is assessed separately.
dimensions.next_verification: Confirm consultation access and representation over the relevant period.
dimensions.applicability: Criminal defence assistance at the identified hearing, distinct from adequate preparation time.

missing_facts: Complete transcript and any undisclosed exclusion or participation barrier.

This zero concerns presence/participation in this hearing only; the separate refusal of defence questioning remains scored under other dimensions.
dimensions.next_verification: Check actual attendance and opportunities to communicate and participate.
dimensions.applicability: Trial presence and defence participation; no absentia issue is asserted.
